verdict.rationale: Folk is a CRM SaaS, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy-posture question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics opt-out, or tracking controls. The pack covers only the API, webhooks, MCP use cases, integrations and pricing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
